request.text: Dear Students and Faculty Members, The Board of Studies has prepared a draft unified syllabus for the course 'Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models' for the academic year 2026-27. It brings together the overlapping content of Generative AI, Natural Language Processing, Speech and Natural Language Processing taught in the programmes AI, COMP, CSE-DS, DS, EXTC, IT, and adds new units on Recall and ranking metrics, Human evaluation, Prompt engineering, Bias based on industry job descriptions. Prerequisites: Data Structures and Algorithms, Python Programming, Applications of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Advanced Techniques in Machine Learning. Faculty members teaching these courses are requested to review the draft syllabus and send their comments to the Programme Chairperson. Students will be informed about the changes to their electives before registration.
